**Migration done.** 36 calls across 12 files now use `db.execute({ sql, params })`.

I left `vendor/legacy-orm/adapter.js` alone. Its header says edits get wiped on upgrade. That file still has 2 old calls.

The read-through cache has its own `cache.query`. It takes a key, not SQL. I did not touch it.

All 78 files pass `node --check`.
